tender.description: Under Kumbh Mela - 2027 the Interlocking tiles work on the Lakshman Jhula link road, surface laying by BC (Bituminous Concrete ) on the Ram Jhula link road and Janaki Jhula link road in the Narendranagar constituency of District Tehri Garhwal.
